# Payment Rules: Require Payment Before Shipping or Pickup

## Overview

An optional switch that stops unpaid or part-paid orders from being handed over or shipped. When it is on, an order must be **paid in full** before it can be marked Picked Up, Shipped or Completed.

Default: **off**.

## Turning it on

1. Go to **Accounts → Settings** and open the **Payment rules** card.
2. Turn on **Require payment before pickup, shipping or completion**.
3. Optional: turn on **Also apply to In-House account orders** (off by default). Use this if you also want In-House account orders checked before they leave.

Only lab admins can change these switches; staff see the card but cannot change it. Every change is recorded with who made it and when.

> Orders that already have an invoice raised always go through, whatever the setting — they are being billed separately.

## What staff see when an order is blocked

- On the **Orders page**, the **Picked Up** button becomes a greyed-out **Requires Payment** button, and *Shipped* / *Completed* disappear from the status dropdowns (single and bulk).
- On **Ship Desk**, the *Ship* / *Complete* / *Notify Customer* action is replaced by a disabled **Requires Payment** button.
- In the **Create Shipment** dialog, a red "Requires Payment — this order must be paid for or invoiced before it can be shipped" notice appears and *Next* / *Save Shipment* / *Save and Print* stay disabled, so no shipping label can be bought.

## What counts as blocked

An order is blocked when the rule is on and its payment state is **Unpaid** or **Part paid**. Always allowed through:

- Cancelled orders.
- On Account (In-House) orders — unless *Also apply to In-House account orders* is on.
- Orders with an invoice raised.
- Fully paid or overpaid orders.

Turning the rule on starts blocking unpaid orders straight away, so tell your staff before you switch it on.
